metadata.description: RSI(14) + EMA(50/200) long-only spot rules for 1h candles. Paper-only.
metadata.name: rsi-ema-spot

spec.description: Apply RSI(14) + EMA(50/200) entry/exit rules on closed 1h candles
spec.instructions: Trade spot long-only on closed 1h candles. ENTRY needs all three: close above EMA50 above EMA200, RSI(14) crossed up through 30 within the last 3 closed candles, last volume above its 20-period average. EXIT on RSI(14) >= 70, close below EMA50, or the risk-manager stop-loss. Never short, never leverage, one position per symbol, ignore intraday ticks. Stale or missing candles (>2 late) means flat with reason stale-data; never invent candles. Return per symbol: signal long|flat, confidence 0-1, reasons, invalidation.
